summary.text: Edras attempts to force the eight gems into one command. The champion defeats the Hollow Regent and speaks a wish that protects choice, restores custody, and leaves a contested world capable of voluntary accord.

chapter.progressionIntent: Concludes the canonical campaign while preserving the live warzone, realm identity, and replayable postgame.

summary.text: Defend the voluntary council, defeat the Hollow Regent, choose the wish's emphasis, restore all eight gems, and establish the postgame accord.

text.text: Defend the council without breaking Accordant Isle's neutral covenant.
Defeat the Hollow Regent and secure the unmade wish.
Speak one voluntary wish emphasis after all four realms are heard.
Return every gem to its rightful realm custodian.
Enter the persistent postgame with the accord and warzone intact.

choice.meaning: Choose Bridges, Vigil, or Renewal. The wording changes epilogue emphasis and cosmetics only; all canonical world-safety invariants remain identical.

mainQuest.completionOutcome: Edras is defeated, all realms remain distinct, every gem returns home, Accordant Isle remains neutral, Dragon's Concordance remains local and consensual, and the world continues with new voluntary bridges rather than forced sameness.

summary.text: Invite optional allies and witnesses earned throughout the campaign to stand with the four-realm council.

mainStoryContribution.text: Returns side-quest characters to the main stage, rewarding attention without changing combat power, final access, or the canonical outcome.

text.text: Review the allies and witnesses who are willing to come.
Give each witness a meaningful noncombat role.
Completed side-quest witnesses appear in the final council and postgame scenes.

summary.text: Restore the names of people erased by Edras's histories so the final wish speaks for lives, not abstractions.

mainStoryContribution.text: Turns the finale from a contest over magical objects into a reckoning with the people harmed by forced unity.

text.text: Gather verified names from the four realms.
Restore the names to the convergence memorial.
Speak the memorial before the final battle.
The ending includes a named memorial and an additional Vaeloryn response.
